sentences.en: New hires are subject to careful monitoring in our firm.
sentences.zh: 我们公司新入职的员工会受到严格的监控。

sentences.en: So why the detailed monitoring? We shall see now.
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么需要详细的监控呢？我们现在就会看到原因。

sentences.en: The young woman is monitoring the production process from start to finish.
sentences.zh: 这位年轻女性从头到尾都在监测生产过程。
